name: std::locale::name
intro: Returns the name of the locale, which is the name by which it is known to the operating system, such as "POSIX" or "en_US.UTF8" or "English_United States.1252". If the locale is not a copy of a system-supplied locale, the string "*" is returned.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The name of the locale or "*" if unnamed.

examples.output:
The default locale is C
The user's locale is en_US.UTF8
A nameless locale is *
